items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: But anyway, we played for him. He even played Calloway over there later. But when we were in the Cotton Club, Stark still was the manager.

ctx.x: The gangsters owned it. And they had a guy in charge of it, Herman Stark... He was a kind of bragging(?) guy, but he didn't have no record against him. So he could be the... He was the front man. He was the Man.
Foots, Remember when we had guys like George Raft that used to come in?
